title: Currencies and country pricing
workflow: Read list_currencies for the base currency, plan availability, current mode and bulk_max.
Enable multi-currency with set_multi_currency. Choose automatic mode with set_auto_exchange_rates before adding additional currencies.

In automatic mode, use set_automatic_currency_enabled or bulk_set_automatic_currencies_enabled with explicit enabled. Enabling a missing currency creates it with rounding_mode none. Display the returned rate_message and re-read list_currencies after bulk operations.

In manual mode, use create_currency or bulk_create_currencies with explicit decimal-string conversion_rate values. Use bulk_update_currency_rates to set or multiply rates, bulk_update_currencies for availability and rounding, and bulk_delete_currencies only after live dependencies are cleared.
Enablement does not assign a currency to countries. Assign the currency to the market, then select it for each country in Pricing. New countries initially use the base currency.

When MARKET_CURRENCY_NOT_READY is returned, show its backend-localized message. details.currency names the currency and details.requirement the first unmet requirement (checkout_limits, checkout_fees, cod, cod_zones or payment_adjustments): add the amount in that currency there and retry. MARKET_DUTY_CURRENCY_CHANGE_LOCKED (details.requirement duties) means a duty rule in another currency must be removed and recreated explicitly.
Recheck storefront Coverage and open the existing country address. Connecting a domain does not create these commercial assignments. Currency tools never require domain or email-settings scopes.

rates.effective: Use conversion_rate and rate_source from currency reads. Show the backend-provided name and rate_message in the merchant's language. automatic_unavailable returns an empty conversion_rate and cannot be priced.
rates.reference: list_exchange_rates and get_exchange_rate are shortened reference displays, not effective pricing rates. Do not substitute their rate_inverse for automatic currency reads.
rates.switch_to_manual: The backend snapshots all additional currencies, including disabled ones, from one complete current snapshot and rounds once to ten storage decimals. Missing rates reject the whole switch. Display CURRENCY_RATES_SNAPSHOT_SAVED's localized message and re-read the saved rates; country selections stay unchanged.

batches: Read bulk_max rather than hardcoding it. All selected changes are atomic; unknown IDs and the base currency reject the whole batch. Currency data cleanup retains its separate impact-preview and single-use confirmation-token workflow. Historical orders and financial snapshots are retained.
notifications: Each rate refresh queues currencies/rates_updated for subscribed stores on automatic rates; the event is never lost or queued twice for a store after a service restart. Delivery is asynchronous and can arrive after prices already use the new rates. Deduplicate by event ID, compare updated_at and re-read list_currencies to reconcile. Enabled currencies and rounding in the payload are read when the event is queued.
